This is the companion to [Astra's First 48 Hours](../2026-09-05-astra-first-48-hours/index.qmd): 82 demonstrations, experiments, and evaluations, grouped by category. It includes the original 72 candidates and ten later additions, including CAD projects, Thornwake, and examples of limitations. The main article develops the findings; this table is for finding something to explore.

Descriptions summarize the creators' accounts and the evidence available on September 5, 2026. Inclusion is not independent validation, and this is not a ranking. Related projects by the same creator remain identified separately. Additional live-demo and code links are included where located.

::: {.catalog-table}
